class.name: NNAngleToVector2SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Scores and filters based on the node minimum and maximum angle compared to the set [member angle_to_direction_vector].
class.description: The [Vector2] angle search criterion scores and filters [Node2D] candidates based on the signed angle (in [code]-180..180[/code] degrees) from [member angle_to_direction_vector] to the node's facing direction ([code]Vector2(1, 0)[/code] rotated by its global rotation). When used for scoring, the angle is mapped linearly from [code]0.0[/code] at or below [member min_angle_degrees] to [code]1.0[/code] at or above [member max_angle_degrees], then passed through [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve] if one is set.

members.member: The direction vector to compare the search space node facing direction to.
Maximum angle in degrees. If the angle is more than this and filtering is applied, the tested node is filtered out.
Minimum angle in degrees. If the angle is less than this and filtering is applied, the tested node is filtered out.
